title: Australia opt not to name T20I vice-captain for England series
description: Mitchell Marsh will not have a formal deputy in the absence of Travis Head, Josh Inglis, Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Nathan Ellis, with a decision to be made only if he is unable to lead at any stage
